browserSession.name: __Host-agenteam_session
browserSession.description: Original Account session cookie; configured loopback HTTP uses agenteam_local_session. No bearer or caller-supplied Actor.

Cursor.description: Opaque signed owned-projects-v1 cursor, bound to current Owner, normalized lifecycle set and created_at-desc,id-desc. Session and page limit are not binding fields. Current Session is checked on every page. At most 8192 decoded UTF-8 bytes; invalid binding/token/size uses CURSOR_INVALID.

Description.description: At most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; server validates this byte bound. Tabs and newlines are allowed.

description.description: At most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; server validates this byte bound. Tabs and newlines are allowed.

Project.description: Current authenticated Owner detail. Full ProjectRef validation includes normalized name and ordered timestamps. The current transaction enforces initialization and Read gate; deleting is unavailable here.
